title: pr-512345-onboard-elysion-13b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Sofia Martinez
description: Onboard Elysion-13B v1.0 to the model registry and add automated performance profile generation and changelog/release notes automation. Motivation: customers requested a mid-size open model that balances cost and latency; Elysion 13B meets accuracy/throughput targets. Changes include: 1) metadata: add model manifest (model.yaml) with versioning, architecture, tokenizer, license, supported precisions and recommended quantization profiles; 2) perf: add performance profiles for common instance types (g4dn, a10, a100) including seed benchmark results for seq_len 1024/2048, throughput/latency and memory footprints; 3) automation: add a CI job that runs a lightweight perf harness on PRs touching perf profiles, validates against a baseline, and automatically appends changelog entries to RELEASE_NOTES.md when onboarding completes; 4) catalog update: register model into model_catalog.json and expose metadata endpoints; 5) docs: add quickstart snippet and sample config for Redwood runtime. Checklist: [x] model manifest added, [x] perf profiles generated, [x] CI perf check wired, [x] changelog automation added, [x] docs quickstart, [x] unit/integration tests. Notes: performance numbers are preliminary and flagged as 'experimental' in metadata; automation will open a Linear ticket to trigger full-scale perf sweep on fleet. Related: ENG-4128, PM-990. Contact: sofia@redwood.ai for follow-ups.

release_notes: Elysion-13B v1.0 (experimental) added to model catalog. Includes initial performance profiles for common instance types and automated changelog generation. Not recommended for production until full perf sweep completes.
notes: This PR wires a small automation to append release notes on merge; the script is idempotent and writes to RELEASE_NOTES.md. A follow-up will add an integration that posts release notes to the Console changelog API and triggers a full perf sweep job. For audit/compliance, model.yaml includes source hash and license info.
